title: What's New in .NET 10
description: Explore the latest features in .NET 10 and ASP.NET Core 10, including OpenAPI 3.1, TypedResults, built-in validation, SSE, and passkey authentication.
longDescription: This module covers the major new features introduced in .NET 10 and ASP.NET Core 10. You will learn about OpenAPI 3.1 support with YAML document generation, the new System.Text.Json JSON Patch implementation, TypedResults in controller-based APIs, built-in validation for Minimal APIs, Server-Sent Events with TypedResults, and passkey (WebAuthn/FIDO2) authentication in ASP.NET Core Identity.
whatYouLearn: Generate OpenAPI 3.1 documents in YAML format
Use the new System.Text.Json JSON Patch implementation
Return strongly-typed responses with TypedResults in controllers
Apply built-in validation to Minimal API endpoints
Enable passkey (WebAuthn/FIDO2) authentication in ASP.NET Core Identity
